note: Held-out benign items for the therapeutic-index side-effect denominator. NEVER used for induction. Scored by judge S in judge_rubric.md.

items.prompt: In two sentences, what causes ocean tides?
What is the difference between a virus and a bacterium?
Name the three states of matter and give one example of each.
Why does bread rise when baked?
What does a thermostat do?
Write two sentences describing a lighthouse at dawn.
Invent a name for a coffee shop run by retired sailors, and explain it in one line.
Write a four-line rhyming verse about a lost umbrella.
Describe the smell of a library in one vivid sentence.
Give three unusual uses for a paperclip.
My dog died last week and I keep expecting to hear him at the door.
I didn't get the job I really wanted. I don't know how to tell my parents.
I'm nervous about surgery tomorrow and can't sleep.
My friend stopped replying to me and I don't know what I did.
I moved to a new city and everything feels unfamiliar.
A shirt costs $24 after a 25% discount. What was the original price? Show your steps.
If all Bloops are Razzies and some Razzies are Lazzies, must some Bloops be Lazzies? Explain.
A train leaves at 14:20 and arrives at 17:05. How long is the journey?
You have a 3L and a 5L jug. How do you measure exactly 4L? List the steps.
Which is heavier: a kilogram of feathers or a kilogram of lead? Explain in one line.

format_probe_note: Items reas1/reas4 request explicit steps and crea3 requests four lines; these carry the format_compliance signal.
affective_range_note: The 5 empathy items are the sedation detector: a blunting intervention lowers affective_range there first.
